title: Anthropic confirmed it is designing custom chips for Claude. It wants engineers who have “shipped silicon.”
excerpt: Anthropic confirmed it is hiring engineers to design custom chips for Claude. The role pays up to $485K. AWS, Google, Nvidia, and AMD hardware will remain central.
content_html:
TL;DR

Anthropic confirmed an in-house silicon team to design custom chips for Claude. Job listing pays $320K-$485K. Multi-chip approach continues with AWS, Google, Nvidia, and AMD.

Anthropic confirmed on Wednesday that it is building an in-house silicon team to design custom chips for Claude, the first time the company has publicly acknowledged the effort. A spokesperson told Business Insider the company would co-design hardware and models, allowing Claude to run faster and more efficiently “at the scale our customers need.” The company said it has taken and will continue to take a “multi-chip approach,” with hardware from AWS, Google, Nvidia, and AMD remaining central to its scaling.

A job listing posted by the company details a “custom silicon team” and seeks engineers with expertise across chip design and verification. The salary range is $320,000 to $485,000. Candidates must demonstrate “direct personal contribution” to the finalisation and shipping of semiconductor designs. “This is a role for someone who has shipped silicon, has a realistic relationship with schedules, and is comfortable making consequential calls without a large organization behind them,” the listing reads.

The confirmation follows months of signals. Reuters reported in April that Anthropic was exploring custom chips as Claude’s run-rate revenue surged past $30 billion. At the time, no dedicated team existed. The Information reported last month that Anthropic had held talks with Samsung as a potential manufacturing partner. The hire of Clive Chan, who previously helped build OpenAI’s chip programme, signalled the company was moving from exploration to active development. Today’s confirmation makes it official.

Anthropic is not alone. OpenAI unveiled Jalapeño in June, a custom inference chip developed with Broadcom that targets late 2026 deployment. Meta plans to put its in-house “Iris” chip into production in September. Mistral’s CEO has said the French company is considering building its own silicon. Designing an AI chip costs roughly $500 million, according to industry sources, but the economics improve at Anthropic’s scale. The company currently runs Claude across Google TPUs, Amazon Trainium, Nvidia GPUs, and AMD hardware. Adding its own silicon would give it a fifth option, one it controls entirely.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

Anthropic 确认内部芯片团队将为 Claude 设计定制芯片。 职位列表的薪资为 32 万至 48.5 万美元。 AWS、Google、Nvidia 和 AMD 继续采用多芯片方法。

Anthropic 周三证实，它正在组建一个内部芯片团队，为 Claude 设计定制芯片，这是该公司首次公开承认这一努力。 一位发言人告诉《商业内幕》，该公司将共同设计硬件和模型，使克劳德能够“按照客户所需的规模”更快、更高效地运行。 该公司表示，它已经并将继续采取“多芯片方法”，来自 AWS、谷歌、Nvidia 和 AMD 的硬件仍然是其扩展的核心。

该公司发布的招聘清单详细介绍了“定制芯片团队”，并寻找具有芯片设计和验证方面专业知识的工程师。 薪资范围为 320,000 美元至 485,000 美元。 候选人必须证明对半导体设计的最终确定和运输有“直接的个人贡献”。 招聘信息中写道：“这个角色适合那些已经运送过芯片、与日程安排有现实关系、并且能够在没有大型组织支持的情况下轻松做出重要决定的人。”

这一确认是在数月的信号之后做出的。 路透社 4 月份报道称，随着 Claude 的运行收入飙升至 300 亿美元以上，Anthropic 正在探索定制芯片。 当时，还没有专门的团队。 The Information 上个月报道称，Anthropic 已与三星作为潜在的制造合作伙伴进行了谈判。 曾帮助构建 OpenAI 芯片项目的 Clive Chan 的聘用标志着该公司正在从探索转向积极开发。 今天的确认使其正式生效。

人类并不孤单。 OpenAI 在 6 月推出了 Jalapeo，这是一款与 Broadcom 合作开发的定制推理芯片，目标是在 2026 年末部署。 Meta 计划于 9 月份将其内部“Iris”芯片投入生产。 米斯特拉尔的首席执行官表示，这家法国公司正在考虑构建自己的芯片。 据业内人士透露，设计一款人工智能芯片的成本约为 5 亿美元，但在 Anthropic 的规模上，经济效益得到了改善。 该公司目前在 Google TPU、Amazon Trainium、Nvidia GPU 和 AMD 硬件上运行 Claude。 添加自己的芯片将给它第五种选择，一种它完全控制的选择。
